title: manni content strategy: journey record
description: A content-strategy journey: an end-to-end outcome a persona reaches with the docs. One record per file, under docs/content-strategy/journeys/. Every field after `type`, `id` and `personas` is optional. A journey that declares `evals` belongs to the golden set, which a bare `manni test tasks` runs.

type.description: Marks the file as a journey (critical user journey) record, which `manni strategy` reads.

id.description: The id pages and other records name this record by. Unique across every record.

title.description: The record's name, as `manni strategy list` and `get` show it. `manni test tasks --journey` tells it to the synthetic user as the task.

description.description: One sentence that says who or what the record is.

personas.description: The ids of the persona records this journey serves. `manni strategy` builds its tree from this field, and a journey may serve several personas.

trigger.description: What starts the journey, in the reader's words. `manni test tasks` tells it to the synthetic user as what started the task.

entry-point.description: The page the journey starts on, as a path or URL. A path resolves against the config file's directory. `manni test tasks` starts the synthetic user there when no page is passed.

success-criteria.description: What the persona has when the journey succeeds. `manni test tasks` tells it to the synthetic user as when it is done, and judges it after each run as the `success` eval.

workspace.description: The directory the synthetic user starts from, relative to the config file's directory. `manni test tasks` copies it fresh into a temporary directory for each run. Absent, each run starts in an empty directory.

evals.description: The journey's golden evals. `manni test tasks` grades each one against the run's trace and workspace after every run. Declaring them puts the journey in the golden set, which a bare `manni test tasks` runs. Each entry is a tracevals eval entry.

id.description: The eval's id, in kebab-case. Unique within the list.

assertion.description: What the eval proves. For `grader: ai` it is the claim the judge decides.

grader.description: How the eval is graded. Default `ai`.

command.description: For `grader: command`: the argv to run in the run's workspace. `{trace}` in an argument is the run's trace path.

success-exit-codes.description: For `grader: command`: the exit codes that pass. Default `[0]`.

timeout-ms.description: For `grader: command`: how long the command may run, in milliseconds. Default 30000.

severity.description: How much a failure counts. Only an `error` fails the run. Default `error`.

target.description: For `ai` and `regex`: what the grader reads. `transcript`, `last-message`, `files`, or `{ source: file, path }` for one file in the workspace.

options.description: The grader's own options, as tracevals takes them.

evidence.description: What the judge should look for, for `grader: ai`.

examples.description: Passing and failing examples for `grader: ai`, as `pass` and `fail`.

items.description: Other keys of the artifact-evals entry, such as type, weight and skip, pass here, and manni test tasks checks the entry against that vocabulary.

steps.description: The journey's stages, each with the page that carries it.

stage.description: What the persona does at this stage.

doc.description: The page that carries the stage, as a path or URL.

note.description: Anything a reviewer of the stage needs to know.
